I connected the screen(tft 2.8 ) to a arduino mega and since the screen took up most of the pins on the arduino mega I decided to make a bridge where the mega shares power and has two data connections to a arduino nano which allowed for more pins. I did not have the ir sensor moduals so I decided to test the device by using the adrino nanos reset button as imput so when I clicked it it changed the score. The arduino mega was powered by a powerbank.

### 2026-09-30 — I added the two ir sensors and taped all cable connections to not allow them to disconnect I then connected all the ir sensors to the nano board and screwed them inside the goal box so when the ball w

**1h**

I added the two ir sensors and taped all cable connections to not allow them to disconnect I then connected all the ir sensors to the nano board and screwed them inside the goal box so when the ball went down in to where the ball goes after a goal is scored it triggered the sensor. I then uploaded the code debugged so code and test and test the device and adjusted the sensitivity to correctly work and not to add points t without a goal and the device worked.
